worldattribute-railMinRadiusNarrow-desc: In blocks, for turns and for changes of slope. Applies to new routes after the world restarts.
worldattribute-railMinRadiusBroad-desc: In blocks, for turns and for changes of slope. Long cars need gentle curves. Applies to new routes after the world restarts.
worldattribute-railSlopeChangeNarrow: Max change of slope, narrow track
worldattribute-railSlopeChangeNarrow-des: Percentage points per block: how smoothly the track goes from level to a climb. 28.5 is a radius of 3.5 blocks.
worldattribute-railSlopeChangeBroad: Max change of slope, broad track
worldattribute-railSlopeChangeBroad-desc: Percentage points per block. Long cars need it smooth: at 1 the bodies of neighbouring cars do not meet on a change of slope.
worldattribute-railMaxSlopeNarrow-desc: In percent: 5 is 5 blocks up per 100 blocks of track. 175 is 60°, that is no separate limit.
worldattribute-railMaxSlopeBroad-desc: In percent: 5 is 5 blocks up per 100 blocks of track.
worldattribute-railClearance: Clearance between tracks above each other
worldattribute-railClearance-desc: In blocks. At 2.5 a bridge needs three blocks. Applies after the world restarts.
worldattribute-railMarkerReach-desc: How many blocks from a track a route point snaps onto it. Applies after the world restarts.
worldattribute-railTrolleysUnattended-de: A moving trolley keeps the chunks under and ahead of it loaded, so it keeps running far from players. Off: it waits at the edge of the loaded world. Applies after the world restarts.
